title: 第三章 失而复得第四章 神秘贝壳
content_zh:
没多久，两人就赶到客运站附近，远远就看到几个，其中一个女人，身材高挑，脸色是海风吹得有些微黑的肤色，一身警服显得格外英姿飒爽，她正揪着一个顶着鸡窝头的中年妇女不放。
“海娇你发什么神经，我可是小东的二婶，一家人，怎么可能去卖了他儿子？我这是看小宝低烧不退，所以带去县医院看病呢！
你凭什么要抓我？”
“这……”
旁边的都露出犹豫之色。
也是啊，单凭这殷东二婶抱着孩子打算上车，确实算不上拐卖孩子的证据，毕竟是亲戚嘛！
“小王，是不是搞错了？”
一悄声问。
王海娇咬着嘴唇，说道：“她没经过孩子父亲允许就抱走小宝，有孩子父亲的报案，就应该按涉嫌拐卖儿童来处理。
啊，东子来了，快，这里！”
殷东没等车停稳，就跳下了车，撞开围观的人群，直冲进去，两眼赤红的看向被他二婶吴金莲抱着的婴儿。
这一刻，他就像孤狼似的低吼一声，冲去把孩子抢夺过来。
他终于找回了儿子！
这一刻，他激动得不能自已，用力在儿子额头上亲了几下。
小家伙似乎有所感应，小脑瓜转了转，眼角有泪珠滚了出来，顺着腮帮子落在他掌心，让他有一种被灼痛的感觉，泪水也夺眶而出。
“小宝，不哭哦。”
殷东颤声说道，怕吓到儿子，刻意压低了嗓音。
他的话音刚落，小宝就睁了眼，泪水未干的眼睛格外黑亮，看到殷东的刹那，眼睛弯成了月牙儿，奶声奶气的吐了一个字：“哭……”
殷东用手抹一把脸，忙说：“不哭，爸爸也不哭。”
小宝咯咯的笑了两声，眼皮又无力的耷拉下来，小猪崽似把脑瓜往殷东怀里拱了拱，又昏昏沉沉的睡了。

“我就说孩子没事吧，同志，你们不能瞎冤枉人啊！”
听到二婶的声音，殷东猛的转身，瞪着二婶，杀气逼人，声音森冷得像是从地狱里传来：“你找死！”
要不是这个毒妇四处造谣，说自己爸妈双双海难身亡是因为阿夏是扫把星，迷信的奶奶又怎会对怀孕九个月的阿夏大打出手，害她动了胎气险些一尸两命，她早产之后也是伤心之极才会抛夫弃子离家出走的！
这个毒妇竟然还不罢休，要把小宝卖掉，简直丧心病狂！
吴金莲只觉得殷东此刻的眼神吓死人，全身控制不住的哆嗦起来，大喊冤枉：“真是好心没好报，我是带感冒发烧的小宝去看病啊！”
啪！
殷东毫不留情一巴掌甩过去，抽得吴金莲转了半个圈，半边脸顿时就肿成馒头。
“你还敢打我？你有什么证据说我是拐卖，你殴打长辈，才是在犯法。
海娇你们还不把这小畜生抓起来！”
二婶捂脸哀嚎，声音尖利刺耳，跟杀猪一样。
殷东不想跟这个黑心二婶说话，抬脚要踢，王海娇却将他扯到一边，劝道：“东子，先去医院检查一下小宝到底什么情况吧，孩子要紧。
你二婶，我先把她带回所里。”
说着，王海娇让一个送殷东去医院，她把吴金莲铐上，拽上了警车。
吴金莲这才慌了神，扒着车门冲着殷东惊慌哭喊：“东子，二婶真是带小宝去县医院看病，不是要卖了他啊！
你跟说下，不要抓二婶啊！”
content_en:
It didn't take long for the two of them to arrive near the passenger terminal. They saw a few people from a distance. One of them was a woman with a tall figure and a slightly dark complexion blown by the sea breeze. She looked particularly heroic in a police uniform. She was holding on to a middle-aged woman with a chicken coop on her head.
"Haijiao, what are you so crazy about? I am Xiaodong's second aunt. How could I possibly sell his son to my family? I saw that Xiaobao's fever would not go away, so I took him to the county hospital for treatment!
Why do you want to arrest me? "
"This..."
Everyone next to him showed hesitation.
That's right. Just because Aunt Yin Dong was holding the child and planning to get into the car, it is indeed not evidence of child abduction. After all, they are relatives!
"Xiao Wang, did you make a mistake?"
asked quietly.
Wang Haijiao bit her lip and said: "She took Xiaobao away without the permission of the child's father. If the father reported the case, she should be treated as suspected of child abduction.
Ah, Dongzi is here, come on, here! "
Yin Dong jumped out of the car before it stopped, knocked through the crowd of onlookers, rushed in, and looked at the baby being held by his second aunt Wu Jinlian with red eyes.
At this moment, he roared like a lone wolf and rushed to snatch the child away.
He finally found his son!
At this moment, he was so excited that he kissed his son on the forehead several times.
The little guy seemed to sense something, and his little head turned. Tears rolled out of the corners of his eyes, and fell on his palms along his cheeks. He felt a burning pain, and tears burst out of his eyes.
"Xiaobao, don't cry."
Yin Dong said in a trembling voice, deliberately lowering his voice for fear of scaring his son.
As soon as he finished speaking, Xiaobao opened his eyes, and his eyes with wet tears were extraordinarily dark. The moment he saw Yin Dong, his eyes curved into crescent moons, and he uttered one word in a sweet voice: "Cry..."
Yin Dong wiped his face with his hands and said hurriedly: "If you don't cry, dad won't cry either."
Xiaobao chuckled twice, and his eyelids drooped weakly. The little piglet seemed to have arched his head into Yin Dong's arms, and fell asleep again.
"I just said the child is okay, comrade, you can't make false accusations!"
Hearing the second aunt's voice, Yin Dong turned around fiercely and glared at the second aunt with a murderous look. His voice was as cold as coming from hell: "You are looking for death!"
If this poisonous woman hadn't spread rumors everywhere, saying that her parents died in a shipwreck because Axia was the scapegoat, how could the superstitious grandma beat up Axia who was nine months pregnant, causing her to have fetal gas and almost kill two of her children? After she gave birth prematurely, she was so sad that she abandoned her husband and son and ran away from home!
This vicious woman didn't give up and wanted to sell Xiaobao, she was so crazy!
Wu Jinlian only felt that Yin Dong's eyes at this moment were frightening to death, and her whole body trembled uncontrollably, and she shouted that she was wronged: "It's so kind and unrequited. I took Xiaobao, who had a cold and fever, to see a doctor!"
Snap!
Yin Dong slapped Wu Jinlian mercilessly, causing Wu Jinlian to spin half a circle, and half of her face was suddenly swollen like a bun.
"You still dare to beat me? What evidence do you have that I am abducted? You are breaking the law by beating an elder.
Haijiao, why don't you arrest this little beast? "
The second aunt covered her face and howled, her voice sharp and harsh, like killing a pig.
Yin Dong didn't want to talk to this black-hearted second aunt and raised his foot to kick him, but Wang Haijiao pulled him aside and advised: "Dongzi, go to the hospital to check what's going on with Xiaobao first. The baby is important.
Your second aunt, I'll take her back to the house first. "
With that said, Wang Haijiao asked someone to take Yin Dong to the hospital. She handcuffed Wu Jinlian and dragged her into the police car.
Wu Jinlian then panicked, holding the car door open and crying in panic at Yin Dong: "Dongzi, the second aunt really took Xiaobao to the county hospital to see a doctor, not to sell him!
Please tell me not to arrest the second aunt! "
